findings: The v0.1 research observer derived currentBuy from streakDays>0 and institutionsAligned from all three streakDays>0.

Current Formal does not do that. currentBuy is derived from current-day foreignNet/trustNet/dealerNet signs; institutionsAligned is a feature boolean whose current producer is foreignNet>0 && trustNet>0 && dealerNet>0.
FULL_FORMAL_SCAN preserves current-day foreignNet/trustNet/dealerNet, so currentBuy and current-producer institutionsAligned are reconstructable from the snapshot.
FULL_FORMAL_SCAN also preserves institutionTotalNet, chipConcentration, avgVolume20Lots and the persisted buy-day values, so the stored Formal score can be replayed.

However the persisted buy-day fields use journalInteger(value)||0, losing the distinction between true zero-day streak and missing raw streak source. Snapshot-only source completeness is therefore not self-authenticating.
